project.description: The setup table in skill/references/setup.md tells a consumer which artifacts to declare and which arrive transitively, and a consuming build fails outright when that is wrong. The split is decided by scope in jawelte-parent: provided dependencies (the Jakarta APIs, Mockito, Hibernate, xbean-naming) are not transitive and must be declared, compile ones (DBUnit, WireMock, Jackson, Spring Data JPA, the cdi-flow recorder) arrive on their own. This scenario reads the poms in the repository and pins both halves, plus the deliberate absence of a cdi-module/impl to core/impl edge that makes jawelte-core-impl an explicit dependency for every consumer.
project.name: jawelte tests/skill scenario 01: the dependency contract skill/references/setup.md documents
